title: Resistance: Fall of Man
why: A launch title that showed the PS3 at its debut. It's also the disc that failed in our founder's console, the reason Vitals exists.

title: LittleBigPlanet
why: 'Play, Create, Share' brought user-made levels to the console mainstream; millions of player creations lived online.
lost: PS3 online servers were shut down (verify date)

title: Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots
why: A PS3 exclusive that leaned on Blu-ray capacity and the Cell for a cinematic finale to a landmark series.

title: Demon's Souls
why: Started the 'soulslike' genre and its asynchronous online messages, leading to Dark Souls and Elden Ring.
lost: Original PS3 online servers shut down in 2018 (verify)

title: Journey
why: A short, wordless game that proved games could be art, and a PSN indie milestone.

title: The Last of Us
why: A late-generation peak, showing what studios that mastered the Cell could achieve.
